name: A Breath of Fresh Air
summary: Four adoptions and the outdoors. Evie, Ivy, Harley and Yvaine come in; the Family goes camping three separate times and meets something that should not exist on every one of them; and Bryn buys the bus. Nova reappears, matured. The Radio of Trans Girl Safety is gifted.
events: ADOPTED: Evie, Ivy, Harley, Yvaine — four in one arc
THREE CAMPING TRIPS, each one featuring a cryptid
BRYN BUYS THE CUDDLE BUS — she names it SLEIPNIR; Torie names it The Fuck Wagon within the week
SUB-ARC SKINWALKER 1 — Nova returns, gentle reintroduction
SUB-ARC SKINWALKER 2 — Evie and Ivy arrive; JAMES gifts the Radio of Trans Girl Safety
FORESHADOW: Yvaine's shadow in the woods
